C0867.title: French Insurer Asefa Hit by Qilin Ransomware Attack
C0867.summary: In June 2025, Asefa, the Spanish subsidiary of French insurance group SMABTP, suffered a Qilin ransomware attack. The attackers claimed to have stolen 210GB of data, including insurance plans for the renovation of FC Barcelona's Camp Nou stadium, and threatened to leak the data to extort a ransom.

references.title: Penalized for Inadequate Data Security Protection; Insurer Hit by Ransomware Attack, Camp Nou Reconstruction
